title: Malaysian-Style Chicken Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic chicken tagine recipe inspired by Malaysian flavors, with a blend of spices and a hint of charred goodness. Perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or clay tagine over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until charred, about 8 minutes.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add Malaysian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add tagine sauce, coconut milk, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve with yummy rice and top with cheese, if using.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
